doc: Character creation — machine-readable mirror of world/creation-ui.md (canonical for behavior + copy). 'Joining the cast' per design §6: creating/hiring a character costs credits AND requires renting in-game housing in game dollars. New characters are not exempt from the sim. Prices adopt rw-monetization-plan-2026-09-22 §2.4–2.5 (PROPOSAL — never contradict in player-facing copy).

price.billing: flat, one-time, charged on approval only (billOnApproval per game-v8) — the charge lands after screening + human review pass
price.refund_rule: denied applications never bill; a post-review denial auto-refunds in full

record_schema.id: h## — hired-character ids, disjoint from C1–C8 mains and A01–A20 ambients
record_schema.owner: player handle — the only account that may ever possess this character
record_schema.name: screened string; never a cast/ambient name, never a real person, never slurs
record_schema.goes_by: optional block name — what the neighbors end up calling them; screened text, collision-checked against the same registry; blank = the block decides
record_schema.age: integer >= 18 — player-possessable characters are adults, always
record_schema.bio: public profile text — screened; this IS the briefing-safe surface

look.doc: structured pickers only — rendering data, not text; no free-text look field exists, so nothing here needs screening
signature: denim jacket, pins on the collar

record_schema.arrival: one-line 'first day on the block' context — screened text
record_schema.unit_id: housing.json listings_live unit, or a room tier
record_schema.bank_game_dollars: starting balance — rent comes out of this, not credits
record_schema.brain: full LLM when possessed or ambient-active; thin AI when owner offline

screening.engine: world/screen.js RWScreen.screenRequest — the SHARED engine, same code path as request.html + mod-console.html; creation adds only the name-collision registry check (not an intent class). If the engine is unavailable the application cannot be billed — never fall back to private rules.
screening.resubmit_rule: denied applications may be edited and resubmitted; resubmissions carry resubmit_n and route to a DIFFERENT reviewer (moderation.json appeal-resubmit). No resubmit fee.
screening.rules: world/moderation-notes.md §3 verbatim — naming strings always get a human review pass (§4)
screening.note: Screening covers what the player WROTE. Once created, the character's emergent behavior is inviolable — no moderation, ever.

what_the_player_authors: initial conditions only: identity surface, look, job application, lease
the character's inner life, secrets, and decisions emerge — players never write scripts, triggers, or loyalties
a hired character may decline a nudge like any main; possession is session-scoped
sim_obligations: pays rent monthly in game dollars — arrears and eviction apply like anyone else
works their job; thin-AI auto-shifts pay baseline wages
possession during a shift earns the same wage + small session bonus (never pay-to-earn-better)
offline owner → character drops to thin AI (cheap), wakes to full brain on return

economics_shown_before_signing.ceiling_rule: units above the ceiling are visible but unselectable — the honest 'out of reach' state at pick time, never a surprise denial after payment
economics_shown_before_signing.runway_rule: if projected income < rent, the UI shows months-until-broke on post-move-in cash (+wages); 'arrives without work' is allowed but the runway is displayed verbatim
economics_shown_before_signing.currency_wall: rent is game dollars only — credits are never offered for it anywhere in the flow

move_in_math.doc: v35 — signing is atomic per leases.json sign_atomic: first month + deposit leave the bank together. The flow must show this before signing, never quietly ignore it.
move_in_math.shortfall_rule: if arrival bank < first month + deposit, the deposit rides a stated payment plan against the first paychecks — shown verbatim, never a waived deposit presented as paid
move_in_math.day_one_cash: arrival bank − first month − deposit (or − first month only when the plan applies)

payday.doc: shifts.md cadence rendered per job row and in the first-week step
payday.weekly: entry + informal roles — Friday, end of day; the first true paycheck lands the Friday after the 5th

job_board.doc: the whole posted board renders — open and filled. jobs.json is canonical.
job_board.openings: finite counts shown verbatim (n openings); -1 = always hiring (churn gig)
job_board.filled: openings=0 rows stay visible behind a fold, unselectable — the board reads honestly instead of showing only open doors
job_board.channels: word-of-mouth posts (market.json channel) carry the label — never a posted card, ask at the counter
job_board.seeking: 'arrives without work' is always selectable — savings only

live_seam.doc: create.html reads game-v8 bridge surfaces when __aiBridge is present; mirrors otherwise. Read-only — the demo never calls a mutation.
live_seam.badge: header shows 'live board' | 'demo board' — the page never pretends to be live

people_layer.doc: v49 — the block's actual names, mirrored from characters.json (cast, k:'cast') and ambients.json (faces, k:'face'). Every row re-verified by the audit gate: w employer tokens resolve into the person's job/venue field, b building prefixes resolve into cast home fields, owns prefixes resolve into the landlord's job field. Ambient homes are not addresses, so faces never carry b.

fields.n: display name (cast full name / ambient full name)
fields.w: job-board employer strings — crew card source
fields.b: building prefix '9xxx Street' — neighbor card source (cast only)
fields.owns: buildings where the registry names this person landlord of record

renders: 'the building you'd land in' card + landlord-of-record line (step 4)
named surface relationships in the briefing
people_layer.honesty: empty states are stated, not padded — 'no regulars on the card yet — the crew introduces itself on shift'; names shown are surface ties, never claimed friendships

names_registry.doc: v49 — the complete taken list rendered on the table (fold on step 1): 8 cast names, 20 ambient first names, 3 role words. Every listed string must match the TAKEN regex — the audit gate checks both directions' agreement.

arrival_window.doc: v49 — a declared landing window rides the hire, like every request declares its action upfront. Part of the 500 cr, never priced separately.
arrival_window.feed: the cast event carries it — 'lands <window>' — so the block sees the arrival on The Wire

registry_entry.doc: v49 — after the briefing, the minted h## record renders field-for-field per record_schema: id/owner, name/age/pronouns, look, arrival+landing, job_id, unit_id, bank after move-in (game dollars), brain mode. Honesty line: 'the whole file — no secret fields exist on it.'
registry_entry.rule: renders exactly the record_schema fields — nothing the player can't see is written on the card

draft.storage: localStorage rw_create_draft_v25 — fields + step + resubmit count + landing pick + goes_by
draft.rules: autosaves on every step render; discarded explicitly or cleared on successful hire; nothing leaves the browser in the demo

pending_queue.doc: v63 — a submitted application keeps its place across a closed page. Pending state persists (rw_create_app_v25: fields + submitted timestamp + resubmit count); reopening create.html shows the queue card (applicant, submitted time, stage, 'nothing charged while pending') instead of pretending the application vanished.
pending_queue.withdraw: a pending application can be withdrawn — never billed; the withdrawal posts to the feed like everything else and the draft survives for editing
pending_queue.resolve: the demo reviewer clears the queue on return; at merge the real human-review desk resolves it — the card is a status view, never a faster lane
pending_queue.never: no queue position is sold, no expedite exists, resubmissions go to a different reviewer not a faster one

day_one_keys.doc: v63 — the keys card after signing: day-one logistics derived from the picks — key pickup (landlord's office for flats, door-on-the-latch + mailed key card for room shares), mailbox name card, first rent-book entry, first shift or the job-hunt runway, and the exact wire line that will post. Conditions and addresses only — never a script for the day.

sketch.doc: v77 — the structured look picks draw a small canvas figure on step 2 and ride the review card on step 6 (drawSketch): silhouette proportions from build, jacket block from palette, one drawn mark per signature. Rendering data only — no new screening surface. Copy must call it a casting-office sketch, never a portrait.

block_capacity.doc: v77 — the total hired faces the block carries. Open design decision §9.5 (cast cap = compute budget); the demo runs the proposal number 12 and labels it the block's carry limit. Per-account slot_cap stays a separate, smaller ceiling.
block_capacity.display: the roster panel and the step-6 quote show the count verbatim ('N of 12 hired faces') — never hidden, never a surprise denial

seat_waitlist.doc: v77 — when the card is full, signing joins the seat waitlist instead of the review pipeline: free, first-come-first-served. Screened at join AND re-screened when a seat offer lands. An offer holds 48 h — unclaimed it passes on. Waiting never bills; leaving is free and posts to the feed like every withdrawal.
seat_waitlist.storage: localStorage rw_create_wait_v25 — fields + joined timestamp + resubmit count; survives a closed page like pending_queue
seat_waitlist.never: no expedite, no seat auction, no paid position — there is no way to pay for a sooner seat
seat_waitlist.demo: the demo seat opens on a clock (~40 s), the way the demo reviewer clears the queue; at merge the real roster state decides

multi_hire.doc: v77 — a second hired character is a stranger to the first, stated verbatim on the review step ('<name> is on the card too — a stranger to them; they meet on the block like anyone else') and in the briefing's surface-relationships line (a stranger, not a contact). What the player knows, neither character does — the briefing whitelist is unchanged.

feed_events.request: hire — '<name>' joined the cast (attributed, status resolved)
feed_events.cast: a new face on the block — <name>, <public bio one-liner> (bio text only post-screen)

progression_hooks: tenant → owner: purchase listings use the same 9xxx addresses; deed fee in credits after the earned game-dollar grind
owner → landlord: landlord license gates on earned in-world standing
